title: qm-odor-prediction: quantum-mechanical descriptor-enhanced molecular representations for odor prediction
description: Code, environment specifications, and processed-data documentation accompanying a manuscript on quantum-mechanical descriptor-enhanced molecular representations for multi-label odor prediction, structural-neighborhood analysis, external sensory-panel validation, and orthogonal consistency analysis against public receptor-response annotations. The manuscript-aligned release contains 4,495 benchmark molecules, 112 standardized odor labels used for modeling, 87 external molecules arranged into 60 structurally similar pairs, and a 43-label sensory vocabulary.
